name: Regulatory Return Submission (COREP Capital) — Participant Interaction
description: Defines, for each phase of JRN-017, what each participant can see (data projection), what actions they can take (entitlements), and what communications they receive (notifications). This is an internal governance journey — all participants are internal staff (PER-059 Senior Manager / SMF holders: CFO, CRO, Head of Regulatory Reporting). No external customers are involved.

participants.participation_scope: The CFO is the designated senior manager accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of all prudential regulatory returns. Active in PH-090 (validation review), PH-091 (sign-off and submission), and PH-092 (post-submission monitoring). Also involved in all exception paths as the accountable SMF holder.

projection.description: The CFO sees the validation summary dashboard showing the COREP return status, XBRL validation results, variance analysis report, and GL reconciliation status. The dashboard provides a traffic-light view of each template area (CA1, CA2, CR SA, CR IRB, MKR SA, OR) with drill-down to individual data points.
data_fields_visible: COREP return status (Draft / Validated / Exceptions / Approved)
XBRL validation result summary (pass/fail count per template)
Variance analysis: quarter-on-quarter movement per template area with explanations
GL reconciliation status (reconciled / unreconciled differences with amounts)
Finance team independent review status and reviewer name
Submission deadline countdown (working days remaining)
Prior quarter submission reference for comparison
data_not_visible: Individual customer-level exposure data underlying the aggregate RWA figures
Model source code or internal model parameters

actions_permitted: Review validation summary and drill into template-level detail
Review variance explanations and request additional detail from CRO or Regulatory Reporting team
Review GL reconciliation evidence
Request re-validation if data quality concerns identified
Escalate unresolved validation issues to Board Risk Committee
actions_not_permitted: Modify COREP data points directly (data integrity — changes must flow through recalculation)
Approve the return at this stage (sign-off is a separate phase)

notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] validation complete — PASS. All XBRL checks passed. GL reconciliation confirmed. Ready for your review and sign-off.
COREP Q[X] [YYYY] validation complete — EXCEPTIONS. [N] XBRL errors, [N] unexplained variances. Regulatory Reporting team investigating. Estimated resolution: [date].

notifications.trigger: Submission deadline T-5 working days and return not yet validated
notifications.content: ALERT: COREP Q[X] submission deadline in 5 working days. Return status: [status]. Action required to maintain on-time submission.

projection.description: The CFO sees the final COREP return package ready for sign-off: the complete XBRL return, validation report, variance analysis with explanations, GL reconciliation evidence, and the Finance team's independent review confirmation. A formal attestation statement is presented for the CFO to sign electronically.
data_fields_visible: Complete COREP XBRL return (all templates)
Validation report with zero exceptions (or documented approved exceptions)
Variance analysis with CRO-approved explanations for material movements
GL reconciliation confirmation from Finance
Finance team reviewer name and review date
Attestation statement: 'I confirm that this COREP submission is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge'
Submission deadline date and days remaining
PRA RegData submission portal status
data_not_visible: RegData system credentials (service account — not personal)

actions_permitted: Review complete COREP return and supporting evidence
Sign attestation statement (electronic signature recorded in WORM store)
Reject return and send back for further validation (triggers return to PH-090)
Request additional supporting evidence before sign-off
Trigger submission to PRA RegData after sign-off
actions_not_permitted: Modify individual data points in the return (must go through recalculation)
Submit to PRA without recording formal sign-off
Delegate sign-off to a non-SMF holder

notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] — CFO sign-off recorded. Submission to PRA RegData initiated.
COREP Q[X] [YYYY] submitted to PRA RegData. Submission reference: [ref]. Acknowledgement pending.
PRA has acknowledged receipt of COREP Q[X] [YYYY]. Reference: [ref]. Post-submission monitoring period begins.

projection.description: The CFO is notified of any PRA queries or identified errors requiring restatement. The post-submission dashboard shows submission status, any open PRA queries, and restatement history.
data_fields_visible: Submission confirmation and PRA reference
Open PRA queries (if any) with response deadlines
Restatement history (if any prior restatements for this quarter)
Next quarter reporting cycle start date

actions_permitted: Review PRA queries and response drafts
Approve restatement submissions (requires CFO sign-off same as original)
Escalate systemic reporting issues to Board Risk Committee
Commission root cause analysis for identified errors
actions_not_permitted: Respond to PRA queries without documented review by Regulatory Reporting team
Approve restatement without root cause analysis

notifications.trigger: PRA query received on submitted return
notifications.content: PRA query received on COREP Q[X] [YYYY]. Query relates to: [template area]. Response deadline: [date]. Regulatory Reporting team preparing response.
ALERT: Material error identified in COREP Q[X] [YYYY]. Restatement required. Root cause analysis initiated. Your sign-off will be required on the restated return.

participants.participation_scope: The CRO is the designated senior manager accountable for risk management. Active in PH-088 (capital data extraction and RWA calculation) and PH-090 (variance review). Also involved in AP-017-001 (variance investigation) and EX-017-003 (model validation expiry).

phases.phase_name: Capital Data Extraction and RWA Calculation

projection.description: The CRO sees the RWA calculation dashboard showing progress of credit, market, and operational risk calculations. Drill-down available to exposure class level for credit risk, desk level for market risk, and business line level for operational risk.
data_fields_visible: Credit risk RWA by exposure class (sovereign, institution, corporate, retail, CRE, SME)
Market risk RWA by desk and risk factor (interest rate, FX, equity, credit spread)
Operational risk capital by business line
Output floor calculation and binding constraint analysis
Quarter-on-quarter movement analysis per risk type
Data extraction status from source systems
Model inventory status — validation currency for all models used
data_not_visible: Individual customer exposure records (aggregate view only at CRO level)

actions_permitted: Review RWA calculation outputs and drill into exposure class detail
Approve or challenge quarter-on-quarter movements
Request recalculation for specific exposure classes if data quality concerns identified
Review model inventory validation status
Approve fallback methodology if model validation has expired (EX-017-003)
Sign off on the capital data package for handover to Regulatory Reporting
actions_not_permitted: Modify calculated RWA figures directly (must trigger recalculation)
Override model validation expiry without Model Risk team review

notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] — capital data extraction initiated. RWA calculation in progress.

notifications.trigger: All RWA calculations completed — CapitalDataPackageAssembled event
notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] — all RWA calculations complete. Total RWA: [amount]. Credit: [amount], Market: [amount], Operational: [amount]. Output floor: [binding/not binding]. Ready for your review.

notifications.trigger: Model validation expired for material model (EX-017-003)
notifications.content: ALERT: Model [model_id] validation expired. This model is used in [exposure class] RWA calculation. Fallback to Standardised Approach may be required. Model Risk team notified.

phases.phase_name: Validation and Quality Assurance — Variance Review

projection.description: The CRO sees variance analysis detail for risk-related template areas. Material movements in credit, market, or operational risk RWA are flagged for CRO explanation and approval.
data_fields_visible: Variance analysis by template area with drill-down to exposure class
Material movement flags (>10% quarter-on-quarter)
Explanatory narratives from Risk team
Historical trend (4 quarters) for each template area

actions_permitted: Review and approve variance explanations for risk-related template areas
Request additional investigation from Risk team for unexplained variances
Confirm that movements reflect genuine business activity
Flag data quality concerns for recalculation
actions_not_permitted: Approve the full COREP return (CFO responsibility)
Modify variance explanations without Risk team input

notifications.trigger: Material variance detected in risk template area
notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] — material variance detected. [Template area]: [prior quarter] → [current quarter] ([% change]). Your review and explanation required.

participants.persona_name: Senior Manager (SMF) — Head of Regulatory Reporting
participants.participation_scope: The Head of Regulatory Reporting leads the operational execution of the COREP submission process. Active in all phases (PH-088 through PH-092) as the operational lead. Reports to the CFO.

phases.phase_name: Capital Data Extraction and RWA Calculation

projection.description: The Head of Regulatory Reporting monitors the data extraction and RWA calculation pipeline. Sees source system extraction status, data quality check results, and RWA calculation completion status.
data_fields_visible: Reporting calendar with submission deadline
Data extraction job status per source system (loan book, trading book, operational loss DB)
Data quality check results (completeness, reconciliation to GL)
RWA calculation progress per risk type
CapitalDataExtractionRequested event confirmation

actions_permitted: Trigger capital data extraction request to Risk Engine Service
Monitor data extraction and calculation progress
Escalate data quality issues to IT Operations and Risk team
Coordinate with Risk team on calculation timeline
actions_not_permitted: Modify RWA calculations (owned by Risk Engine Service / CAP-004)
Override data quality checks

notifications.trigger: Reporting cycle start — reporting calendar trigger
notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] reporting cycle started. Quarter-end date: [date]. Submission deadline: [date] (T+30). Data extraction initiated.

notifications.trigger: Data extraction failure or data quality check failure
notifications.content: ALERT: Data extraction issue for COREP Q[X]. Source: [system]. Error: [description]. IT Operations notified. Impact on timeline: [assessment].

projection.description: The Head of Regulatory Reporting sees the COREP return construction workspace. Shows template population progress, automated vs manual mapping status, and unmapped data point list.
data_fields_visible: COREP template population status per template (CA1, CA2, CR SA, CR IRB, MKR SA, OR)
Automated mapping completion percentage
Manual classification items requiring analyst judgement
Unmapped data points list with classification options
XBRL taxonomy version in use
Draft return preview

actions_permitted: Review and approve manual classification decisions
Assign manual classification items to reporting analysts
Review draft return preview
Confirm XBRL taxonomy version is current
Trigger COREPReturnDraftGenerated event when consolidation is complete
actions_not_permitted: Override automated mapping rules without documented rationale
Submit the return to PRA (CFO sign-off required)

notifications.trigger: CapitalDataPackageAssembled event received — ready for consolidation
notifications.content: Capital data package received. COREP template consolidation can begin.
ALERT: PRA has updated COREP XBRL taxonomy. Current version: [v]. Required version: [v]. Updated taxonomy must be obtained before consolidation can proceed.

projection.description: Full validation dashboard access. The Head of Regulatory Reporting coordinates the validation process and tracks resolution of any validation exceptions.
data_fields_visible: All validation results (XBRL, variance, GL reconciliation, independent review)
Exception resolution tracking
Finance team review status
Validation audit trail

actions_permitted: Run XBRL validation checks
Coordinate variance analysis with Risk and Finance teams
Coordinate GL reconciliation with Finance
Track and resolve validation exceptions
Prepare validation report for CFO
Trigger COREPValidationCompleted event
actions_not_permitted: Sign off on the return (CFO responsibility)
Override XBRL validation failures

notifications.content: XBRL validation: [N] errors in [template areas]. Review and correction required.

projection.description: The Head of Regulatory Reporting prepares the sign-off package for the CFO and executes the PRA submission on the CFO's instruction.
data_fields_visible: Sign-off package contents
CFO review status
PRA RegData submission portal status
Submission confirmation and reference number

actions_permitted: Prepare and present sign-off package to CFO
Execute PRA RegData submission on CFO instruction (after sign-off recorded)
Record PRA acknowledgement receipt
Trigger COREPReturnSubmitted and COREPReturnAcknowledged events
actions_not_permitted: Submit to PRA without recorded CFO sign-off
Record CFO sign-off on behalf of the CFO

notifications.content: COREP Q[X] [YYYY] submitted to PRA. Reference: [ref]. Awaiting PRA acknowledgement.

projection.description: The Head of Regulatory Reporting monitors for PRA queries and manages any restatement process.
data_fields_visible: Submission status and PRA acknowledgement
PRA query inbox
Restatement tracking (if applicable)
Next quarter cycle timeline

actions_permitted: Draft responses to PRA queries
Initiate restatement process if material error identified
Prepare root cause analysis and remediation plan
Coordinate next quarter cycle preparation
actions_not_permitted: Respond to PRA queries without CFO/CRO review
File restatement without CFO sign-off

notifications.content: PRA query received on COREP Q[X]. Query: [summary]. Response deadline: [date].
